title: Seeking Alpha Agent — Autonomous Intraday Options Agent

milestones.name: Proving Ground: journal-only pipeline (plan M1)
milestones.acceptance: tv-webhook POST -> saa.triggers + open saa.shadow_trades (wrong secret -> 401); saa.outbox insert -> sent_at (or recorded error); market-data calendar/quotes rows; shadow-scorer closes a trade with r_result/mfe/mae + unit test; manual fire of the 7:40 brief task writes saa.briefs + saa.checklists + outbox; validate green, pushed. Gate to M2: 10 consecutive trading days of complete records.

milestones.name: Daemon core: data plane (plan M2 part 1)
milestones.acceptance: Full sandbox session run logs heartbeat, >=380 1-min bars per index symbol, chain snapshots every 5 min, zero unhandled exceptions; pytest green; saa.run_log shows the run.

milestones.name: Rules engine + Kelly sizing + shadow ledger with real marks (plan M2 part 2)
milestones.acceptance: Property tests for every Tier 1 rail; replay of >=5 recorded sessions is deterministic; Kelly tests reproduce plan 0.3 table (6%/16%/24%).

milestones.name: Paper execution, approval mode, dashboard (plan M2 part 3)
milestones.acceptance: >=3 sandbox round trips reconciled; /halt flattens within 10 s; approval timeout logged as Skip; Playwright screenshot of dashboard with live sandbox data. Gate to M5: >=30 paper trades, expectancy > 0, avg loss ~ -1R, >=90% checklist compliance, zero Tier 1 breaches.

milestones.name: Live, approval mode on the VPS (plan M3)
milestones.acceptance: First live trade only after Approve; 5 sessions reconciled to the cent; missing-heartbeat alert verified. Gate to M6: 20 live trades, no incidents, expectancy > 0.

milestones.name: Full auto (plan M4)
milestones.acceptance: Unattended live session with trades reported; forced Tier 1 breach refused and logged in sandbox; status review until Ryan ships.
